artworks.title: The Heraclidae Drawing Lots for the Peloponnese (engraving of an antique gem)
artworks.description: Engraving after the antique gem — the Heraclidae drawing lots for Argos, Messenia, and Sparta, the Return's partition.

artworks.title: The Heraclidae Drawing Lots (woodcut of a Graeco-Roman engraved gem)
artworks.artist: Unknown (woodcut published by C. W. King)
artworks.description: King's woodcut of the Roman gem — three warriors at the urn, Temenus, Cresphontes, and Aristodemus casting for the Peloponnese.

artworks.title: Lucanian Red-Figure Column Krater with the Children of Herakles (Herakleidai)
artworks.artist: Attributed to the circle of the Policoro Painter
artworks.description: Lucanian krater — the children of Heracles, the exile line that will reclaim the Peloponnese in the Return.

popCulture.title: Heracleidae
popCulture.description: The sons of Heracles reclaiming the Peloponnese — the Return remains Greek myth's great story of exile ended by force.

popCulture.title: Heracles
popCulture.description: The hero's line outlives his pyre — Hyllus and the Heraclids carry his name into Dorian legend.
